rows.name: [XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Dunban-san, have you seen Fiorung?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I have. She said she was going out to get[XENO:n ]
some air. I don't think she went far.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Thanks. I'll take a look.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung, here you are.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Ah, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]What's wrong?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's nothing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's...so peaceful.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It's hard to believe that we defeated[XENO:n ]
a horde of Telethia just minutes ago.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Zanza wants to finish us all. So he can[XENO:n ]
make the vision he's had come true.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We're in the calm before the storm.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]They'll be back, won't they? The Telethia...[XENO:n ]
To remove us all from this world...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I won't let that happen.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Whatever the future holds, we can never give in.[XENO:n ]
Not to Zanza... No, not even to our destiny.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I wonder why Alviss said what he did.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Which part?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Does this world belong to us, or to Zanza?[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Why would he side with Zanza?[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Power? Or maybe he wants to live forever.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Who knows...[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]But I don't think his motives are that simple.[XENO:n ]
I'm sure Alviss has some kind of plan.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Otherwise, why would he speak[XENO:n ]
to me in my dreams?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He spoke to you in your dreams?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]That's another reason why I have to find Zanza.[XENO:n ]
I have to find out why.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You and me both.[XENO:n ]
I must fulfil Maynus's wish![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Shulk? You wanted to speak[XENO:n ]
to me about something?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Oh, that's right.[XENO:n ]
Linada-san's looking for you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]She wants to examine you.[XENO:n ]
She's back at Junks.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Oh...[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Hey...umm... Can you go ahead?[XENO:n ]
I'll go and see Linada-san in a minute.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I need a few minutes to myself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK. No problem.[XENO:n ]
Take your time.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Thank you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]What can I do?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]If I go to see Linada-san, she'll find out[XENO:n ]
what's happening to my body.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I need to come up with a good excuse.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Please... Let me be with Shulk[XENO:n ]
just a little bit longer...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
